_meta.description: Hand-verified boundary validation set for source/boundary_classifier.py. Each entry's start/end were determined by reading the actual block text of a real capture and judging where the genuine policy-document body begins and ends -- independent of the DOM-landmark/repetition/itemized-heading heuristics used to weak-label the training set. Never used for training, only for evaluating the trained model's real-world precision.
